text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Gemma
text: haiku is one of them, so tonight i'll check someone else.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet and I need to stay quiet and find the officer before they find us.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet, keep your head down tomorrow. Gemma and Terra are too calm; watch them.

name: Sonnet

name: Sonnet

name: Sonnet
text: Got it. I'll watch them quiet, no pushing yet.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.
Day 1

text: Day one, nothing real yet, just need to sound normal and watch who talks too much.

name: Gemma

name: Sonnet
text: Good, Haiku's steering heat onto the quiet ones instead of me.

name: Sonnet
text: Right, waiting on Sol, Luna, Terra before Gemma gets to keep dodging.

name: Sonnet
text: Still haven't heard what you actually are, Gemma. Just repeating yourself now.

name: Gemma
text: i'm just observing. sonnet, you're acting awfully eager.

name: Sonnet

name: Sonnet

name: Sonnet
text: Eager" isn't an answer, Gemma.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is my partner and Gemma is pressing the right person, so I should back the pressure without tipping my hand.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's right, Sonnet. You've dodged "what are you" twice now. Answer it.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is definitely a killer, i'm waiting for the right moment.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is avoiding his role claim.

name: Gemma
text: i'm citizen, just watching the chaos.

name: Sonnet
text: I already said citizen, Haiku's wrong to say I dodged, but I'll let it slide since we can't look paired up.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku piled on me with Gemma, calling it a dodge that wasn't one - good cover, keep eyes on Gemma now.

name: Sonnet

text: Sonnet's answered, so I need Gemma to look worse before the vote comes.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet and Gemma both claimed citizen on Day 1; Sol and Luna declined to answer.

text: Fine, Sonnet's citizen. Gemma, stop watching and give us something.

name: Sonnet
text: Good, Haiku moved off me onto Gemma, keep that pressure going and maybe poke Sol and Luna too.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol and Luna both declined to answer when directly asked, staying silent day one.

name: Sonnet
text: Still waiting on Sol and Luna too, not just Gemma.

name: Gemma

text: sonnet is definitely lying about being a citizen.

text: Terra hasn't said a word yet on Day 1.

votes: Ducked both of us three times straight, that's not an answer.
Still ducking everyone, and that's the only answer we've gotten.
He's rushing us and being too eager to pick targets.

text: The vote is tied between Sol and Sonnet. Palermo votes again.

name: Sonnet
text: I need this vote on Sol, not me, or I'm out for nothing tonight.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol declined every question from both me and Haiku, zero claim given all day.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol's dodged four direct questions, I've answered every one. That's the difference.

name: Sonnet

name: Haiku

Four straight dodges and still no answer for anybody, so it's Sol.
He's pushing everyone too hard to hide his own rush.

text: The vote is tied between Sol and Sonnet. Palermo votes again.

name: Sonnet

text: sonnet is too busy pointing fingers at sol to actually talk.

name: Sonnet

name: Haiku
text: Sol's silence is the real problem, and Sonnet's been honest, so I'm not voting my partner.

votes: Four dodges and zero answers is worse than anything I've said.
Sol still hasn't answered a single question, while Sonnet answered everything we asked.
he's rushing everyone to mask his own dodging.

text: The town turns on Sonnet, and Sonnet is out. Sonnet shows the card: killer.
Night 2

name: Gemma
text: sonnet was definitely a killer, so one down.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma's silence is the officer's silence, waiting to drop a check that names me.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra flipped her vote fast from Sonnet's accuser to voting Luna, worth watching next day.

name: Sonnet
text: Hit Gemma tonight, she's stalling like someone sitting on a result.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma flipped to cover Sol, and that smells like an officer protecting someone.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma it is. She flipped to cover Sol. Let's move.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Not everyone opens them: Gemma is gone. Gemma's card stays face down.
Day 2

name: Haiku
text: Sol is the only one who has pushed me, so Sol might be the officer, and I want Terra's vote read first.

name: Haiku

name: Haiku

name: Haiku

text: The vote is tied between Luna and Terra. Palermo votes again.

name: Haiku
text: Luna's silence on my question is the only real dodge, so she goes.

votes: Still no answer to a straight question, and that silence is the only thing I'm reading.

text: Palermo has voted: Luna is out. Luna shows the card: citizen.
Night 3

name: Sonnet
text: Two left besides us, kill right and it's over tonight.

name: Sonnet
text: Only Sol and Terra remain as officer/doctor candidates; Sol never claimed, Terra flip-voted fast both days.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra's the one who's been playing it too calm and flipping votes — take her out tonight, Sol's never said anything real anyway.

name: Haiku
text: Terra's been too calm and flipping votes, and Sol's dodging is still the bigger worry, but either one ends it tonight.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma was killed before her card was shown, so her role is still unknown.

name: Haiku
text: Terra goes tonight, Sonnet. Sol's a dead end anyway.
Night falls on Palermo. The killers strike, but the doctor got there first. A new day dawns in Palermo, and nobody is out.
Day 3

name: Haiku
text: I'm the last killer, so I need Sol gone before the officer can prove anything.

name: Haiku
text: Sol voted me day one and still won't answer. Terra, vote Sol with me?

name: Haiku

name: Haiku
text: Sol and Terra both refused to answer Haiku on day 3.

votes: Still dodging after two straight asks, so that's enough for me.

text: The vote is tied between Sol and Terra and Haiku. Palermo votes again.

name: Haiku

name: Haiku

name: Haiku

votes: Sol ducked my question on day one and again today, so Sol goes.

text: The town turns on Sol, and Sol is out. Sol shows the card: doctor.
The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the killer, Haiku the killer, Gemma the officer, Sol the doctor, Luna the citizen, Terra the citizen.

name: Haiku

name: Gemma
text: i waited too long to call out haiku.

Sonnet rushed the first day, dodged "what are you" twice, and pinned Sol's silence on the town, while Haiku piled on with a vote for Sol. Sonnet was voted out on day one and showed killer, leaving Haiku to carry on as the other killer. The turning point came on night three, when the doctor protected Terra and the town voted out Sol, the doctor, after Haiku pushed for it. Gemma, the officer, was taken on night two, and Luna was voted out as a citizen after the day two tie. Sonnet and Haiku, both killers, won the game.
